fx.notes: The bundled FX snapshot is a planning reference. A customs declaration or bank rate may differ and can be entered by the user.

general.label: General goods
general.notes: The user must confirm the HS classification, duty treatment, exemptions and any product-specific excise.

vehicle.label: Vehicle
vehicle.notes: Vehicle age, engine, valuation, steering and environmental rules are handled by the dedicated car-import calculator.

NG.customsValuationBasis: CIF or the assessed customs value entered by the user

duty.notes: The correct CET or national tariff rate depends on the confirmed HS line.

levies.name: CISS
levies.description: Comprehensive Import Supervision Scheme charge on FOB value.

levies.name: ETLS levy
levies.description: ECOWAS Trade Liberalisation Scheme levy on customs value.

vat.notes: Nigeria Tax Act 2025 sections 147 and 149 place import VAT on the imported value plus non-VAT taxes, duties and import charges.

limitations: Duty rate, exemptions, prohibitions and import-adjustment-tax treatment require the exact tariff line.
The suspended 4% FOB charge is not included; confirm the live declaration before relying on CISS or collection-charge treatment.

sources.title: Nigeria Trade Portal duties and taxes simulation

KE.customsValuationBasis: CIF or the customs value entered by the user

duty.notes: EAC CET rates, sensitive-item rates, stays and remissions depend on the confirmed tariff line.

excise.notes: Imported excisable goods use customs value plus customs duty as the excisable value.

levies.name: Import declaration fee
levies.description: General rate under the current Miscellaneous Fees and Levies Act; exemptions and special rates can apply.

levies.name: Railway development levy
levies.description: General rate in the consolidated Act effective 1 January 2026; exemptions can apply.

vat.notes: Import VAT is calculated on customs value plus customs duty and applicable excise.

limitations: EAC sensitive-item rates, duty remission, exemptions and product excise are not inferred.
The current consolidated law controls where older KRA explainer pages show superseded levy rates.

sources.title: Miscellaneous Fees and Levies Act — current consolidated text

GH.customsValuationBasis: Transaction value adjusted for transport, handling and insurance to Ghana

duty.notes: Ghana applies ECOWAS CET bands; classification and origin must be confirmed in ICUMS or by GRA Customs.

levies.name: NHIL
levies.description: National Health Insurance Levy under the VAT reforms effective 1 January 2026.

levies.name: GETFund levy
levies.description: Ghana Education Trust Fund levy on the same 2026 tax base.

vat.notes: From 1 January 2026 VAT, NHIL and GETFund are calculated separately on the same base rather than cascading.

limitations: AU, ECOWAS, examination, processing, special import and product levies vary by declaration and are entered as other assessed statutory charges.
Upfront VAT payment, reliefs and input-credit treatment are outside this planning estimate.

sources.title: GRA VAT reforms and current rates

ZA.customsValuationBasis: Customs value under sections 65–67 of the Customs and Excise Act

duty.notes: The tariff can be ad valorem, specific or formula-based. Enter a percentage only when it matches the confirmed tariff treatment.

excise.notes: Product-specific excise and environmental levies are not assumed.

vat.notes: The added tax value normally includes a 10% customs-value uplift plus non-rebated duties. The uplift does not apply to qualifying origin in Botswana, Eswatini, Lesotho or Namibia.

limitations: Preferential origin, rebates, anti-dumping, safeguard, formula and specific duties are not inferred.
The origin selector only controls the SARS VAT uplift exception; it never guesses a preferential customs duty.

sources.title: SARS Valuation of Imports External Policy
